items.title: Google Expands Ads In AI Mode To 10+ Countries, Adds Multiturn Ads
items.excerpt: Google is expanding ads in AI Mode to 10+ English-language countries and launching multiturn ads (ads on follow-up queries) in the U.S., with notes on what PPC advertisers get in reporting.

items.title: Google Ads Tests A Weekly AI Report Card For Your Ad Creative
items.excerpt: Some Google Ads accounts show an Asset activity page that uses AI to deliver weekly insight cards on ad creative, including headline ideas to test.

items.title: Meta Paused Its New Business Terms, And Businesses Should Plan As If It Never Gets Better
items.excerpt: Meta removed 'train' from the crawl clause of its updated business and ad terms, kept 'develop', then paused the Nov. 20 terms entirely after advertiser pushback over AI use of business website content.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads While It Creates Your Image Live
items.excerpt: OpenAI's promised visual ad format appears live: when users ask ChatGPT to make an image, an ad is shown while the image is being generated.

items.title: Businesses in ChatGPT Business Hub Live With Click Data
items.excerpt: OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT, a hub giving brands analytics on mentions, profile views and clicks from ChatGPT to their websites.

items.title: OpenAI's new business agents give brands a free way into the conversation it's also selling as an ad
items.excerpt: OpenAI is giving brands a free route into ChatGPT conversations through verified business agents, while keeping control of the data and recommendations it also monetizes through ads.

items.title: Ad Tech Briefing: Amazon's auction trial puts agentic advertising's trust problem in focus
items.excerpt: Unsealed FTC allegations over Amazon Ads' auction practices sharpen questions about trusting Big Tech black boxes as buyers hand bidding to AI agents.

items.title: Amid Holiday Commerce Push, Reddit Tests an AI-Powered Product Review Portal
items.excerpt: Reddit is testing product review pages that use AI to compile product discussions from across the platform, part of its holiday commerce and shopping-ads push.

items.title: OpenAI Gives Brands Some Data About How They Appear in ChatGPT
items.excerpt: OpenAI's new business tool shows brands how they appear in ChatGPT, competing with the sprawling industry of GEO specialists.

items.title: Shopify Noses Further Into Ad Tech With Campaign Autopilot Expansion
items.excerpt: Shopify is expanding its AI-driven Campaign Autopilot ad product, using its first-party merchant data to push further into retail-media-style advertising.

items.title: Reddit Taps Qloo To Strengthen Its Predictive Targeting
items.excerpt: Through a partnership with Qloo's taste-correlation AI model, Reddit will target users with relevant ads based on correlated interests without needing search queries or browsing history.

items.title: TIME's AI Agents Do The Coordinating, And Its Sellers Still Do The Selling
items.excerpt: TIME is using Kana's AI agents to draft ad proposals and troubleshoot campaigns, but not to replace the human relationships that drive ad sales.

items.title: Priceline's AI agent Penny lands in Snapchat ads amid holiday rush
items.excerpt: Priceline is the first travel brand to use AI Sponsored Snaps, which let advertisers bring their own chatbots into Snapchat, putting its Penny AI agent in ads.

items.title: Synthetic audiences fall short: What marketers need to know
items.excerpt: AI-generated audience simulations may make it harder for brands to reach new audiences, argues RYA co-founder Mark Himmelsbach.

items.title: Adobe and Pepsi ads ran on AI recipe sites with fake chefs, DecryptAds finds
items.excerpt: DecryptAds found major-brand ads on 2,100+ AI-generated recipe sites with fake AI chefs; Italy's HBagency manages ads.txt for 1,631 of them, raising brand-safety and disclosure questions.

items.title: Brainlabs warns Meta's AI creative could leave brands unsure what worked
items.excerpt: As Muse Image heads to Advantage+ creative, Brainlabs warns that ceding ad creative to Meta's AI keeps creative learnings inside the walled garden.

items.title: TikTok updates its AI video ad tools
items.excerpt: TikTok's Symphony ad-creation platform now has access to the latest Dreamina Seedance video model, expanding AI video ad creation options for brands.
